_source:
A real 'Zambian Language Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's Languages Department) was shared with this project via Drive, in two overlapping forms: (a) a combined document covering Terms 1, 2 and 3 in one file, and (b) separate standalone Term 1 and Term 3 documents. A teacher's name and school name were found in the header/footer of every one of these documents and are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy. This is a genuine gap fill -- this app previously had no Zambian Language Form 2 content at all (only Form 1 Term 3).

The combined Terms 1-3 document is the more complete and internally consistent of the two real sources: it carries a fuller, consistently-numbered set of sub-topics (e.g. Term 1 runs through 2.1.1-2.1.4, 2.2.1-2.2.3, 2.3.1-2.3.3) than the standalone Term 1 file, which stops short at 2.1.1-2.1.3 and 2.3.1.1-2.3.1.2 with several rows missing their own specific-competence codes -- an apparent earlier or rougher draft of the same real scheme. The standalone Term 3 file matches the combined document's own Term 3 content almost verbatim (same real competences, same real weeks), confirming it is the same underlying source rather than independent content; it is treated as a rougher duplicate and not used to add anything beyond the combined document. A third variant, re-exported under a 'Languages Department' filename, was also checked and its content matches the same Term 3 material again -- also excluded as non-independent.

Two literal duplicate re-uploads were identified and skipped: the combined Terms 1-3 document was uploaded twice (identical file size), and the standalone Term 3 document was uploaded twice (identical file size).

A genuine structural irregularity in the source is preserved rather than silently fixed: Topic 2.4 (Language Structure) begins with sub-topic 2.4.1 (Nouns) in the very last week of the Term 1 scheme, before its main development across Term 2 -- this file places 2.4.1 Nouns under Term 2 (where the bulk of the topic's own content and the syllabus's own Term 2 heading sit) and notes the Term 1 bridge in its own description, rather than duplicating or inventing a separate Term 1 placement. Term 3 genuinely revisits several Term 1/2 topic numbers (2.1 through 2.5) at a more advanced, consolidating level with their own new real sub-topics and competences (e.g. 2.1.5 Story Telling, 2.1.6 Public Speaking, 2.2.4 Study Skills, 2.3.1.7-2.3.1.8) -- this spiral structure is real in the source and is preserved as-is rather than merged into the earlier terms.

Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Zambian Language
subject.description: Zambian Language syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2024).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 Conversations
sub_topics.description: Conversational listening and speaking skills built around national values, debate, cultural values, and distinguishing fact from opinion.

competencies.description: Discuss national values and principles (patriotism, respect, hard work) using appropriate language
Gather information on a given topic and debate it (introducing motion, proposing, opposing, interjecting, rebutting)
Discuss cultural values (respect, hospitality, dressing, responsibility) using appropriate language
Distinguish facts from opinions in conversations, speeches or meetings

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 Drama
sub_topics.description: Acting out plays built on cross-cutting themes.

competencies.description: Act out plays on cross-cutting themes (human rights, mental health, social and emotional issues) using appropriate language

sub_topics.name: 2.1.3 Songs
sub_topics.description: Listening to, singing, and analysing traditional and contemporary songs.

competencies.description: Listen to, sing, and discuss the meaning of traditional and contemporary songs

sub_topics.name: 2.1.4 Riddles and Puzzles
sub_topics.description: Initiating puzzles and analysing them.

competencies.description: Initiate puzzles and provide/analyse answers to them

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Intensive Reading
sub_topics.description: Reading form-level texts with understanding, then summarising and paraphrasing them.

competencies.description: Read a variety of form-level texts with understanding, answer questions, discuss vocabulary, summarise and paraphrase them

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Reading Aloud
sub_topics.description: Reading form-level texts aloud with accuracy, pace, and expression.

competencies.description: Read form-level texts aloud with accuracy, pace and expression

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Extensive Reading
sub_topics.description: Reading a variety of texts and summarising them orally or in writing.

competencies.description: Read a variety of texts and summarise them orally or in writing

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Composition
sub_topics.description: Discussing the features of different composition types and writing them: biography, expository writing, application letters, descriptive writing, report writing, and minutes.

competencies.description: Discuss the features of a biography and write one
Discuss the features of an expository composition and write one
Discuss the structure of a formal letter and write an application letter
Discuss the structure of a descriptive composition (places, objects) and write one
Discuss the features of a report and write a report about a given event
Discuss the features of minutes and write minutes of a recorded meeting

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 Summary
sub_topics.description: Summarising a given text into a paragraph.

competencies.description: Discuss prose summary features and summarise a given text into a paragraph

sub_topics.name: 2.3.3 Dictation
sub_topics.description: Writing dictated passages correctly.

competencies.description: Write dictated passages correctly

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Nouns
sub_topics.description: Noun classes and grammatical agreement. Introduced in Term 1's final week (as the bridge into Term 2's grammar focus) and consolidated here.

competencies.description: Identify grammatical agreement in sentences and categorise nouns into noun classes, expressing agreement accordingly

sub_topics.name: 2.4.2 Pronouns
sub_topics.description: Types of pronouns and subject-object concord.

competencies.description: Construct sentences expressing subject-object concord; identify and classify pronouns (possessive, demonstrative)

sub_topics.name: 2.4.3 Adjectives
sub_topics.description: Types of adjectives.

competencies.description: Discuss adjectives (number, colour, quality) and sort and use them correctly

sub_topics.name: 2.4.4 Conjunctions
sub_topics.description: Types of conjunctions and their role in sentences.

competencies.description: Identify coordinating, correlative, and contrastive conjunctions and classify them
Discuss the role of conjunctions (contrast, reason, condition) and use them in sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.4.5 Interjections
sub_topics.description: Meaning and use of interjections.

competencies.description: Identify and use interjections in sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.4.6 Punctuation
sub_topics.description: Use of punctuation marks in texts.

competencies.description: Discuss and apply punctuation marks (capital letters, comma, full stop) in texts

sub_topics.name: 2.4.7 Word Building
sub_topics.description: Building words using affixation and derivation.

competencies.description: Build words from stems and roots using affixes
Form nouns from verbs and verbs from nouns (derivation) and use the derived words in sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.4.8 Onomatopoeia
sub_topics.description: Identifying and using onomatopoeic words.

competencies.description: Identify onomatopoeic words and construct sentences using them

sub_topics.name: 2.4.9 Tenses
sub_topics.description: Forms of the future tense.

competencies.description: Identify future tense markers and construct positive, negative, and interrogative sentences in the future tense

sub_topics.name: 2.4.10 Active and Passive Voice
sub_topics.description: Constructing and transforming active and passive sentences.

competencies.description: Identify active and passive sentences, and change active to passive voice and vice-versa

sub_topics.name: 2.4.11 Figurative Language
sub_topics.description: Proverbs and sayings.

competencies.description: Discuss the meaning and use of proverbs; categorise and apply them
Discuss the meaning and use of sayings in specific situations

sub_topics.name: 2.4.12 Vocabulary
sub_topics.description: Word meaning at form level.

competencies.description: Discuss the meaning of vocabulary and use it correctly in sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Translation Techniques
sub_topics.description: Applying translation techniques (adaptation, amplification, compensation) to translate text between English and the Zambian language.

competencies.description: Apply various translation techniques to translate text from English to a Zambian language and vice-versa

sub_topics.name: 2.1.5 Story Telling
sub_topics.description: Narrating fiction stories and analysing their moral lessons.

competencies.description: Narrate fiction stories coherently and analyse their moral lessons

sub_topics.name: 2.1.6 Public Speaking
sub_topics.description: Delivering a speech on a given topic.

competencies.description: Deliver a speech using appropriate language on a given topic

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Intensive Reading
sub_topics.description: Reading a variety of form-level texts with understanding, at a more advanced level than Term 1.

competencies.description: Read a variety of form-level texts with understanding and answer comprehension questions, discussing vocabulary

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Reading Aloud
sub_topics.description: Reading form-level texts aloud with accuracy, pace, and expression.

competencies.description: Read form-level texts aloud with accuracy, pace and expression

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Extensive Reading
sub_topics.description: Reading diverse texts and summarising them.

competencies.description: Read diverse texts and summarise them orally or in writing

sub_topics.name: 2.2.4 Study Skills
sub_topics.description: Locating information from reference resources.

competencies.description: Locate information from reference materials (dictionaries, magazines)

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Composition
sub_topics.description: Writing articles and argumentative compositions.

competencies.description: Discuss the features of articles and write one for a magazine or newspaper
Discuss the features and structure of an argumentative composition and draft and write one on a given topic

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 Summary
sub_topics.description: Summarising a given text into a paragraph, at a more advanced level.

competencies.description: Discuss prose summary features and summarise a given text into a paragraph

sub_topics.name: 2.4.3 Adjectives
sub_topics.description: Reviewing adjectives.

competencies.description: Review adjectives and construct sentences using them correctly

sub_topics.name: 2.4.4 Conjunctions and 2.4.5 Interjections
sub_topics.description: Consolidating conjunction usage and interjections in complex sentences.

competencies.description: Consolidate conjunction usage (contrast, condition, reason) in sentences
Use interjections effectively in complex sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.4.9 Tenses and 2.4.10 Active/Passive Voice
sub_topics.description: Mastering future tense constructions and consolidating active/passive voice transformation.

competencies.description: Master future tense constructions (positive, negative, interrogative)
Consolidate active and passive voice transformation

sub_topics.name: 2.4.11 Figurative Language
sub_topics.description: Applying proverbs and sayings to specific situations.

competencies.description: Identify and categorise proverbs and sayings appropriate to specific situations and functions

sub_topics.name: 2.4.12 Vocabulary
sub_topics.description: Advanced form-level vocabulary.

competencies.description: Discuss the meaning of advanced form-level vocabulary and use selected vocabulary correctly in sentences

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Translation Techniques
sub_topics.description: Translating complex texts between English and the Zambian language.

competencies.description: Apply various translation techniques to translate complex texts between English and a Zambian language
